claims.text: For the RE Mobile app, the manual says the minimum supported iOS version will be one version behind the current iOS release.
For Android, the manual says the app's minimum supported version will be two versions behind the current Android OS.
The manual also states that Huawei phones are not compatible with the app and that support is not offered for them.

This partly answers your question. The retrieved manual information gives only the minimum-supported-version policy; it does not establish whether the app works with a specific OS release that came out this week.

unanswered_parts: Whether the app works with a newly released phone OS version
